content.comment_body: Could someone clarify which input pins on [product_name] controllers can read high-speed pulse signals from an encoder?
Not all [product_name] controllers provide fast input capability. Only certain models have 4 fast inputs, typically labeled I3 to I6.
Thanks for the info. I've successfully read pulses using the I3 pin on my [product_name] controller.
